{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Check for internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
internal_test_mask = df_completed['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Print the count and sample of such rows
print(f"Internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99) in completed set: {internal_test_count}")
print(f"Sample of internal test orders (if any): {df_completed[internal_test_mask][['order_id', 'revenue_numeric']].head().to_string(index=False)}")

# Exclude internal test orders
final_df = df_completed[~internal_test_mask]

# Compute total revenue
total_revenue = final_df['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Print only the required numbers
print(f"completed_orders_count: {len(final_df)}")
print(f"total_revenue: {total_revenue:.2f}")"}
